GEOGRAPHY — TERMLY EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Water Cycle and Action of Rivers is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Water Cycle and Action of Rivers as rumours only.
   B. Explain Water Cycle and Action of Rivers with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Water Cycle and Action of Rivers.
   D. Say Water Cycle and Action of Rivers never happens in Kenya.

2. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Destroying road signs

3. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Hide all money underground

4. Which statement about Vegetation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Vegetation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Vegetation never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Vegetation as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation.

5. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.

6. Which statement about Weather is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Weather.
   B. Explain Weather with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Weather never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Weather as rumours only.

7. Which statement about Soils is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Soils never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Soils as rumours only.
   C. Explain Soils with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Soils.

8. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Name the president
   D. Replace the compass rose

9. Which statement about Climate is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Climate as rumours only.
   B. Explain Climate with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Climate never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Climate.

10. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   C. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Which statement about Mass Wasting is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Mass Wasting with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Mass Wasting never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Mass Wasting.
   D. Treat Mass Wasting as rumours only.

12. Which statement about Elementary Surveying is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Elementary Surveying.
   B. Treat Elementary Surveying as rumours only.
   C. Explain Elementary Surveying with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Elementary Surveying never happens in Kenya.

13. Which statement about Weathering is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Weathering with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Weathering never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Weathering as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Weathering.

14. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   D. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.

15. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nairobi
   C. Nakuru
   D. Mombasa

16. Which statement about Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in.
   B. Say Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in as rumours only.
   D. Explain Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Weathering and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Mass Wasting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Soils and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Water Cycle and Action of Rivers and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Wildlife and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
